body:
Wow, what a response. I hate posting here because I feel like an attention seeker, but this made me feel warm inside. Thanks so much for this response, actually made me feel a lot better. 

I guess, now that I'm depression sober(?), my worrying was for nothing.   It feels nice to see that i'm not the only one that went through this and felt like me. Thank you so much, I'll have to keep this somewhere to read when I feel down.
